import sys, json
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp')
from tlib import run

# base fabric: 2 nodes, one link, P=8
def base(**kw):
    f = {"n":2,"interval_ns":1,"slice_ns":8,"offset_ns":0,"drift_ppb":[0,0],
         "heat":[],"anchors":[],"links":[
            {"ends":[[0,0,0],[1,0,0]],"delay_ns":[1,1],"defer_rounds":[0,0]]}
            if False else {"ends":[[0,0,0],[1,0,0]],"delay_ns":[1,1],"defer_rounds":[0,0]}],
         "slices":[[0]],"blackouts":[],"guards_ns":[0],"reconfig_ns":0}
    f.update(kw)
    return f
prof = {"groups":1,"jitter_ps":[0],"measurements":[]}

def trace(**kw):
    t = {"rounds":3,"rates_ppb":[[0,0],[0,0],[0,0]],"bias_ps":[0],"sends":[],
         "lost":[],"reboots":[],"queries":[3]}
    t.update(kw)
    return t

# 1. port priority: lower ID served first; higher ID busy even if lower is lost
fab = base()
tr = trace(rounds=2, rates_ppb=[[0,0],[0,0]],
           sends=[[2,0,0,0],[1,0,0,0]], queries=[1])
res = run([{"op":"replay","profile":prof,"fabric":fab,"guard_ns":0,"trace":tr}])[0]
assert res['send_status']==['port_busy','sent'], res
assert res['delivered']==1 and res['adopted']==1, res
assert res['states'][0]['adopted']==[None,1], res
tr = trace(rounds=2, rates_ppb=[[0,0],[0,0]],
           sends=[[2,0,0,0],[1,0,0,0]], lost=[1], queries=[1])
res = run([{"op":"replay","profile":prof,"fabric":fab,"guard_ns":0,"trace":tr}])[0]
assert res['send_status']==['port_busy','lost'], res
assert res['delivered']==0 and res['pending']==0 and res['adopted']==0, res
print('port priority ok')

# 2. staleness: reboot of source or dest before application
tr = trace(rounds=3, rates_ppb=[[0,0]]*3, sends=[[5,0,0,0]], reboots=[[1,0]], queries=[1,3])
res = run([{"op":"replay","profile":prof,"fabric":fab,"guard_ns":0,"trace":tr}])[0]
assert res['stale_payloads']==1 and res['delivered']==1 and res['adopted']==0, res
assert res['states'][0]['generations']==[1,0], res
tr = trace(rounds=3, rates_ppb=[[0,0]]*3, sends=[[5,0,0,0]], reboots=[[2,1]], queries=[1,3])
res = run([{"op":"replay","profile":prof,"fabric":fab,"guard_ns":0,"trace":tr}])[0]
assert res['stale_payloads']==0 and res['adopted']==1, res
print('staleness ok')

# 3. anchor service beats reboot same boundary and does not stale
fab2 = base(anchors=[[1,1,2]])
tr = trace(rounds=3, rates_ppb=[[0,0]]*3, sends=[[5,0,0,0]], reboots=[[1,1]], queries=[1])
res = run([{"op":"replay","profile":prof,"fabric":fab2,"guard_ns":0,"trace":tr}])[0]
assert res['states'][0]['errors_as']==[None,0], res   # reboot then anchor -> 0
assert res['states'][0]['adopted']==[None,5], res     # strict improvement over unknown
assert res['stale_payloads']==0 and res['adopted']==1, res
print('anchor/reboot ok')

# 4. strict improvement: packet with bound 0 never replaces anchored bound 0
fab3 = base(anchors=[[0,0,8],[1,1,2]])
tr = trace(rounds=3, rates_ppb=[[0,0]]*3, sends=[[5,0,0,0]], queries=[1])
res = run([{"op":"replay","profile":prof,"fabric":fab3,"guard_ns":0,"trace":tr}])[0]
assert res['adopted']==0 and res['delivered']==1, res
assert res['states'][0]['adopted']==[None,None], res
print('strict improvement ok')

# 5. equal bounds prefer smallest id
fab4 = base(links=[{"ends":[[0,0,0],[1,0,0]],"delay_ns":[1,1],"defer_rounds":[0,0]},
                   {"ends":[[0,1,0],[1,1,0]],"delay_ns":[1,1],"defer_rounds":[0,0]}],
            slices=[[0,1]])
# two sends at tick 0 from different ports, same dest, identical carried bound
tr = trace(rounds=2, rates_ppb=[[0,0],[0,0]], sends=[[30,0,0,0],[20,0,2,0]], queries=[1])
res = run([{"op":"replay","profile":prof,"fabric":fab4,"guard_ns":0,"trace":tr}])[0]
assert res['adopted']==1, res
assert res['states'][0]['adopted']==[None,20], res
print('tie-break ok')

# 6. unknown payload
fab5 = base()
tr = trace(rounds=3, rates_ppb=[[0,0]]*3, sends=[[9,0,0,0]], queries=[3])
res = run([{"op":"replay","profile":prof,"fabric":fab5,"guard_ns":0,"trace":tr}])[0]
assert res['unknown_payloads']==1 and res['delivered']==1 and res['adopted']==0, res
assert res['always_known']==False and res['peak_known_abs_as']==0, res
print('unknown payload ok')

# 7. pending and delivered split; receiver aging and signed drift; peak
# drift node1 = 3ppb, T=2 -> +6 as per interval; anchor node 0 always
fab6 = base(interval_ns=2, slice_ns=16, drift_ppb=[0,3],
            anchors=[[0,0,8]],
            links=[{"ends":[[0,0,0],[1,0,0]],"delay_ns":[3,3],"defer_rounds":[1,0]]} if False else
                   {"ends":[[0,0,0],[1,0,0]],"delay_ns":[3,3],"defer_rounds":[1,0]}])
# phase p: rho = (0+2p)%16; eligible: rho>=0, rho+3+0<=16 -> 2p<=13 -> p<=6
tr = trace(rounds=4, rates_ppb=[[0,3],[0,3],[0,3],[0,3]], sends=[[7,0,0,0]], queries=[0,1,2,4])
res = run([{"op":"replay","profile":prof,"fabric":fab6,"guard_ns":0,"trace":tr}])[0]
# dt = ceil(3/2)+1 = 2+1 = 3 -> applied at tick 3 (delivered), query 4 sees it
assert res['send_status']==['sent'], res
assert res['delivered']==1 and res['pending']==0, res
# carried bound = 0 + hop(0) + aging over [3,6]ns: intervals k=0..2
# k=0: [0,2) cap [3,6) -> none; k=1: [2,4) -> [3,4) =1ns; k=2: [4,6) -> 2ns
# eff rate 3ppb -> 3*1 + 3*2 = 9 as
st = res['states'][2]
assert st['bounds_as']==[None,9], (res,)
assert st['errors_as']==[None,9], (res,)   # actual rate 3 -> same
assert st['adopted']==[None,7], (res,)
assert res['always_known']==False        # node1 unknown before tick 3
print('aging/pending ok')

# 8. pending count
tr = trace(rounds=2, rates_ppb=[[0,0],[0,0]], sends=[[7,1,0,0]], queries=[2])
res = run([{"op":"replay","profile":prof,"fabric":fab,"guard_ns":0,"trace":tr}])[0]
assert res['pending']==1 and res['delivered']==0, res
print('pending ok')

# 9. status precedence: not_in_slice > blackout > guard > port_busy
fab7 = base(blackouts=[[0,0,8]])
tr = trace(rounds=2, rates_ppb=[[0,0],[0,0]], sends=[[4,0,2,0]])
res = run([{"op":"replay","profile":prof,"fabric":fab7,"guard_ns":0,"trace":tr}])[0]
assert res['send_status']==['not_in_slice'], res   # link 1 not in slices[0]... code 2 -> link 1
tr = trace(rounds=2, rates_ppb=[[0,0],[0,0]], sends=[[4,0,0,0]])
res = run([{"op":"replay","profile":prof,"fabric":fab7,"guard_ns":0,"trace":tr}])[0]
assert res['send_status']==['blackout'], res
fab8 = base(blackouts=[[0,0,1]])
# guard violation at phase0: rho=0, guard... need guard; use guard 1 with S=8? 2g<S ok
tr = trace(rounds=2, rates_ppb=[[0,0],[0,0]], sends=[[4,0,0,0]])
res = run([{"op":"replay","profile":prof,"fabric":fab,"guard_ns":2,"trace":tr}])[0]
assert res['send_status']==['guard'], res   # rho=0 < 2
print('status precedence ok')

# 10. peak with signed errors and pre-reboot values
fab9 = base(anchors=[[0,0,8]], drift_ppb=[5,0])
tr = trace(rounds=3, rates_ppb=[[5,0],[-5,0],[5,0]], sends=[], queries=[0,1,2,3],
           reboots=[[2,0]])
res = run([{"op":"replay","profile":prof,"fabric":fab9,"guard_ns":0,"trace":tr}])[0]
# node0 anchored at each boundary; but drift between: t0 err 0, t1 err 0 (anchor at 1)
# interval drift is wiped by anchors each boundary -> peak 0?  anchor covers all phases
assert res['peak_known_abs_as']==0, res
fab10 = base(anchors=[[0,0,1]], drift_ppb=[5,0])   # anchor only phase 0
tr = trace(rounds=3, rates_ppb=[[5,0],[5,0],[5,0]], sends=[], queries=[0,1,2,3])
res = run([{"op":"replay","profile":prof,"fabric":fab10,"guard_ns":0,"trace":tr}])[0]
# P=8 so anchor only at t=0. err: t0: 0; t1: 10 (5ppb*2ns? T=1 here -> 5*1=5)
# T=1: interval drift 5*1=5 as. t1: 5, t2: 10, t3: 15 -> peak 15
assert res['peak_known_abs_as']==15, res
assert res['always_known']==False   # node1 never known
print('peak ok')

# 11. peak counts pre-reboot value
fab11 = base(anchors=[[0,0,1]], drift_ppb=[5,0])
tr = trace(rounds=2, rates_ppb=[[5,0],[5,0]], sends=[], queries=[0,1,2], reboots=[[1,0]])
res = run([{"op":"replay","profile":prof,"fabric":fab11,"guard_ns":0,"trace":tr}])[0]
# t0: err 0 (anchored); interval0 drift +5 -> t1 pre-reboot err 5 -> peak 5, then reboot
assert res['peak_known_abs_as']==5, res
assert res['states'][1]['errors_as']==[None,None], res
print('pre-reboot peak ok')

# 12. reboot at tick R visible in query at R
tr = trace(rounds=2, rates_ppb=[[0,0],[0,0]], sends=[], queries=[2], reboots=[[2,1]])
res = run([{"op":"replay","profile":prof,"fabric":fab,"guard_ns":0,"trace":tr}])[0]
assert res['states'][0]['generations']==[0,1], res
print('reboot at R ok')
print('hand-crafted replay tests all OK')
EOF
cd /workspace/tmp && python3 test_replay2.py
